items.title: Extreme drought and heat from the last El Niño signal a 'new normal' for tropical forests
items.summary: During the 2023–2024 El Niño, about 75% of the world's tropical forest areas experienced at least six months of unprecedented simultaneous drought and heat. According to a study published in Earth's Future, this scenario offers more than just a snapshot of an extreme event; it offers a preview of the "new normal" for the next two decades if greenhouse gas emissions are not reduced.
items.imageAlt: Extreme drought and heat from the last El Niño signal a 'new normal' for tropical forests

items.title: 'Time doesn't heal': Parents of October 7 attacks victim Aner Shapira
items.summary: The parents of a 22-year-old Israeli man who was killed when Hamas attacked the Nova music festival on October 7, 2023 have told FRANCE 24 how they can still feel him surrounding them even though he's no longer here. Shira and Moshe Shapira say that time doesn't heal, but they are learning how to live with their loss.
